credentials.storage: macOS Keychain (managed by gh CLI; profile recorded in ~/.config/gh/hosts.yml)
used_by: Kent (manual git + gh CLI from Mac)
credentials.notes: OAuth user-to-server token issued by GitHub CLI's OAuth app (token prefix gho_). Scopes as of 2026-05-11: gist, project, read:org, repo, workflow. This is NOT a manually-created classic or fine-grained PAT — rotation is via `gh auth login --hostname github.com`, not via the 'Generate new PAT' flow in GitHub settings. office2 does not hold a copy of this credential; kgale and claude users on office2 use the kg-felix-bot identity instead.
credentials.expiry_notes: OAuth user-to-server tokens issued by gh CLI do not carry a fixed expiry but can be revoked by: rotating via `gh auth logout --hostname github.com && gh auth login --hostname github.com --git-protocol https`; revoking GitHub CLI's OAuth app at https://github.com/settings/applications; account password change; or extended inactivity. macOS Keychain stores the new token automatically after re-auth. Cross-check scopes match expectations after each rotation: `gh auth status` should show `repo`, `read:org`, `workflow` at minimum.
